_doc: Per-file char budgets for instructions/memory files (GHI #373). AGENTS.md was tightened 40k→15k by OBPI-0.0.54-01 as a moderate-compromise target; OBPI-0.0.54-03 measured a ~31k transitional floor with the current monolithic template. The hard ceiling is Codex's 32768-byte project-doc cap: a per-turn budget above it would green-light a silently-truncated surface (enforced by tests.governance.test_agents_md_map_doctrine / test_agents_md_map_doctrine_application _budget_within_codex_cap). 2026-06-04: OBPI-0.0.37-26 LANDED the interim #519 relief — the local splice (.gzkit/agents.local.md) was hand-compressed 9,306→4,997 bytes, dropping rendered root AGENTS.md to 28,342 bytes, under the then-30000 interim ceiling and ~4.4 KB under the Codex byte cap (genuine context reduction, not a budget-at-cap stopgap). This supersedes the transient budget-at-cap reading (32768) that only flipped the gate green without shrinking the surface. The committed rendition (renditions/agentcontract-codex-root-interim.md) is the durable payload OBPI-21/22's composer regenerates deterministically. The <15k destination remains GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37. 2026-06-22 (operator-ratified): AGENTS.md raised 30000→31000 to seat the corpus-faithful render of the full invariant-tier floor (all 45 entries verbatim render to 30,631 chars / 30,806 bytes). The prior 30000 ceiling could only be met by a rendition that DROPPED invariant entries — i.e. by drift — so the budget was holding the surface honest at the cost of the invariant floor. 31000 matches OBPI-0.0.54-03's measured transitional floor, fits the faithful render with headroom, and stays ~1.9 KB under the 32768 B Codex hard cap (no silent-truncation risk). The <15k destination via corpus splitting remains the durable goal (GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37). CLAUDE.md 4000 and .claude/rules/*.md 15000 remain from OBPI-0.0.54. 2026-06-30 (operator-directed, budget-tuning explicitly deferred — 'we will use that for tuning later, the mechanism to do so is now in place'): AGENTS.md raised 31000→31800 to seat the corpus-faithful render of 5 new invariant-tier guardrails captured from the 2026-06-30 insights report (pipeline-stage discipline, no --no-verify, narrow-scope discipline, defect/deferred-claim honesty, surface-blockers-upfront). Measured claude/root render = 31,569 bytes (invariant 9,612 / compressible 21,957); 31800 clears it whether counted as chars or bytes and holds ~968 B under the 32768 B Codex hard cap (no silent-truncation risk). This GROWS the surface against the <15k shrink goal (GHI #533 / ADR-0.0.37) — the operator booked that tension as later tuning, not a blocker; the corpus-splitting destination is unchanged.
